name: semitexa/ssr
description: Semitexa SSR - Twig-based server rendering with components, layouts, assets, and deferred slots

suggest.semitexa/scheduler: Required for automatic scheduled sitemap regeneration (daily cron job)
suggest.semitexa/theme: Publishes theme-base, whose pages/error-page.html.twig this package renders for 404 and 500. Without it those fall back to FallbackErrorPage, a pure-PHP page with no styling. Not a require: semitexa/theme requires this package, and the pair would be a cycle.
